concept:
Character concept for a 2D cut-out animation game. Draw ONE original creature: a mighty azure THUNDER DRAGON coiled in many loops among storm clouds, the THIRD stage of a three-stage Wood evolution line whose first stage is image 6: the same azure dragon fully grown, with deeper scales, golden back spikes and flat lemon-yellow lightning, in the same view and pose as image 1, coiled in many loops in mid-air with the head raised high, claws out, on a plain white background. A cute, chunky creature, but an original design that must look clearly DIFFERENT from the figure the silhouette came from; not any existing character.

Image 1 (grey silhouette) and image 2 (the same figure split into numbered regions) show the PUPPET RIG the new creature will be animated on. They tell you where each part and joint is, NOT what the creature looks like: do not trace their outline. Viewer-left and viewer-right mean as seen in the picture.

KEEP FROM THE RIG (the animation moves these parts around these joints):
- the same parts, no more, no fewer, each where its numbered region is: 1 head with face, crown, mane and horns; 2 long whiskers; 3 coiled serpent body; 4 two arms with claws; 5 golden back spikes; 6 tail with a white tuft; 7 storm clouds; 8 lightning bolts;
- every joint where it is and every part pointing the same way as in image 1; eyes where the old eyes are;
- each part about the size and shape of its region; the whole figure about the same size.

CHANGE (the new look, region by region):
1 head with face, crown, mane and horns: an eastern-dragon head of deep azure-teal scales facing the viewer-right with cream-yellow lips and chin, one big golden-amber eye (one catchlight dot) exactly where the old eye is, brow angled down, jaws a little open in a confident grin with small fangs; two coral-gold antler horns sweeping back to the viewer-left where the silver blades are, a flowing white mane streaming back to the upper viewer-left where the dark blade is, and a small pale turquoise-jade crown with a coral-gold rim on top of the head where the bottom of the old crescent crest is (much smaller than the old crest); no silver, no armor, no red gem.
2 long whiskers: two long thin white whiskers growing from under the cheek and streaming forward and down past the snout to the viewer-right, gently wavy; no silver, no gold.
3 coiled serpent body: the same serpent body in DEEP azure-teal scales (a few simple scale arcs) with a cream-yellow belly along the inner edge where the gold-and-cream belly is; the small silver blades along the back become short warm golden spikes; no red rune, no silver.
4 two arms with claws: two short deep azure-teal dragon arms: round shoulders (the TOP ends, joining the body), hands with cream-yellow palms, and big curved coral-gold claws in the same places and shapes as the old gold claws.
5 golden back spikes: golden dorsal spikes and fins of the dragon in the same places: the big winged plate becomes a fan of sharp golden spikes (a dorsal fin) pointing back the same way, the shoulder plate a smaller fan of golden spikes, the blade and the band two golden spike ridges on the top coil, the two small blades two short golden spikes; flat warm gold with a few darker gold lines; no silver, no red marks, no armor.
6 tail with a white tuft: a deep azure-teal dragon tail with a cream-yellow underside rising the same way, its tip ending in a flowing white hair tuft with a small flat lemon-yellow zigzag lightning bolt, where the old ring is; no ring, no orb, no glow.
7 storm clouds: storm clouds in the same places and sizes: flat grey-purple cloud puffs with rounded curls and a white band along their edges, thin white trailing streaks; the two wind swirls become long flat grey-purple storm clouds with white rims; no cyan, no mint, no yellow.
8 lightning bolts: flat lemon-yellow zigzag lightning bolts in the same places: one bigger bolt on the viewer-right, two or three small bolts on the viewer-left; flat colour with the dark ink outline, no glow, no white core, no sparks.

ATTITUDE: a fierce but cute storm dragon: brow angled down, jaws a little open in a confident grin showing small fangs; cute, never scary, never a cheerful mascot.

{RENDER}
{DESIGN}
The style sheet is image 3; the hand-drawn map is image 4. Image 5 is an approved character of this game: copy its ink line weight and its pencil and crayon texture, not its design; it has a few white shine spots and some darker shading: do NOT copy those. Image 6 is the approved first stage of this creature: keep its colours, face and drawing style; this stage is the same creature grown up.

COLOURS: DEEP azure-teal blue scales (darker than image 6, still blue-teal, NOT green), a cream-yellow belly, warm golden back spikes, a flowing white mane, coral-gold antler horns, long white whiskers, a small pale turquoise-jade crown with a coral-gold rim, big golden-amber eyes, flat lemon-yellow lightning bolts, grey-purple storm clouds with white rims. Few colours.

AVOID: a green body or green scales, sky-blue or cyan clouds, a bronze helmet or crest with carved spiral patterns, heavy bronze armor plates, silver-and-gold armor blades, red rune marks, a glowing red chest orb, a gold ring ornament on the tail, cyan water splashes, a lavender wind swoosh, text, labels, numbers, the region colours, frames, background scenery, a second view, shading, shadows, white highlights, glossy shine, glow, gradients.
